从一个方向，到一份有依据的成果。: From a direction to an evidence-based outcome.
比较方向，把已有经历放到具体要求旁。缺少的材料与尚未明确的部分，也一起留下。: Compare directions and connect experience to specific requirements. Keep missing evidence and open questions visible.
把缺口变成一次小范围尝试。先划清投入与交付边界，再决定是否继续。: Turn a gap into a small experiment. Define the time and deliverable before deciding what comes next.
把选择、行动与变化连接起来。形成有依据的报告，为下一次调整和求职表达提供材料。: Connect choices, actions and changes in an evidence-based report for your next decision and job application.

数据质量处理与独立分析范围: Data quality and scope of independent analysis
用一次小实践，验证数据质量处理。: Explore data quality with one small practice.

合成预算 · 预计投入不代表掌握程度: Example budget · Estimated time does not indicate proficiency

先探索数据分析，保留 AI 应用备选: Explore data analysis; keep AI applications as an alternative
一次小范围实践与本人贡献记录: One small practice with a personal contribution record
补充表达与验证，继续调整计划: Improve communication, validate and adjust the plan
报告预览 · 不编造经历或能力结论: Report preview · No invented experience or ability claims
